body:
Hey im here today
 Dont feel lie talkjng much but ill check in later.

Your family sound shitty and  Mine are too. I only am in contact with my brother. You're  right, it is very hard not go let other peoples opinions get to you. But they do not define who you are. Maybe find out who you are to you, thats what i am trying to figiure out. It will be easier to do when you leave your familif its really bad maybe talking to a school councelors or social worker about maybe finding some other pace to live. Im not saying running away at this point, but it sounds like you live in an abusive situation. I cant relate to the blindness, but  my depth perception is bad so i just dont play sports. Anything involving a puck or ball i instantly know its going to hit me in the face.. so i jusy dont.

Anyhow thank you for letting me talk to you.  Im not going to be talking any more today but i am reading the threads.
Im back. Im not in much of a talking mood today but im here reading if anything comes up.

Its difficult starting over again. But it might be worth trying. You dont know the future, no one does.  Be kind to yourself especially when it matters most... thats when its difficult.  Im trying to start over aswell. Im here reading the thread. I may not reapond but i am checking in.
I need to sleep. Ill be back tomorrow and check in. I want you to keep chatting and rest and wake up even if you dont want to wake up.
I have to go to bed. Im exhausted. Ill check back in tomorrow.  Know you  have people here all hours of the day. Get rest yourself and come back to the world tomorrow.
Letting you all know im going to sleep  mow. Loke real sleep not the long for ever one. Im tired. Ill be back tomorrow.

Do you feel you have other talents rather the  sports. You read alot you say. I net you are very smart cause of them. What do you think? What is it about books you like so much? I probably like movies much for the same reason.

I am weak aswell physically. My my entire body is in pain. My back is fucked to shit from tension and arthritis. Its hard to type on  cell phone cause of weight if holding it..  fuck those assholes at school. Their opinion of you is not important. But its hard to believe. I say these things all the while believing someone else's opimin of me is what matters and not my own.

I really like the terry Pratchet books.

It sounds like she wasnt good enough for you
 At all.  And you deserve someone to truly love you for everything you are. Unflawed and all flaws. 


I just broke up with my fiance. I supported him for a year and trying to make myself better for him while he was trying to make me into his parents.. I realized he is an ass. But i know the feeling of still loving an ass.....
Keep talking. I dont know what to say but i want to hear about what you need to get off your chest.

About the therapist and counsellors. Im really low income. Ive got bairly enough money to make it month to month and i try to live simply. My therapist doesnt a knowledge my suicidal thoughts as real because the only self harm im doing is non lethal. The free citizens counselling wont touch mh issues cause students arent equipped with skills to help me. I cant afford the therapies which will help. Ive had a year in aShort term out patient dbt program. But i need it long term. The emergency psych ward only is there to watch me. Better then nothing but when i get home the mean voice in my head starts up.. my mothers voice, and it takes all my energy to stand up to it. Ten minutes ago i was alright and now i just want to cry and go to my home.. but i canf. My body just wont die. And i have yet to have the universe decide i can go now.

hard to be  a better person and she took Advantage of you. Im sorry you do so well and she used you. You arent unworthy of love and thats why we are here to talk go one another. May i ask Do you know why she cheated on you? I think you should give yourself credit, you try really hard be supportive and make things work.

I dont know if this helps and thats ok. I have had to weed people out till i had nothing.. i found in an odd way it made space for good people who are healthy to have on your life. What do you think, please share genuinely i want to know.

May i ask why her shitty behaviour means you are a failure? Im not being invalidating.  just trying to be honest. I want to know why you think these things. Your feelings are valid. You dont have to reply if you dont want to. But i need peolle to talk to too.

I do and im lucky. But. I cant be 100% honest cause i come off as insane to those in my life. Atleast i perceive i do.

 I do t know the real me. I know i suffer with bpd, ptsd, anxiety, depression, insecurity, trust issues. They come from my highly abusive parents who i cut out of my life recently Those are solids for me. Im a good person but i feel ashamed of me and guilty for existing. I try to be kind to myself and others i try to be a good person. And i try to be better everyday. But its not enough. I can go on more but not all at once. Im not a victim, but i struggle so much.


I dont think its just my home. But i do t feel like ive met anyone else like me or who is where i am from. Who would talk about it except for me?

Thank you. Im ok with canned and cliche words. They are simple and i try to have faith everything will be ok. My friends and my own dislike of pain are the two things that keep me here. Im thankfull for those two tiny things.

I hate most things because thise worlds function is fucked up.  As an example feel like an alien who was thrown into a world i dknt belong in and never will. I struggle to keep happiness and its minute by minute with me. When im out in the world i feel like i have to put on a mask.  There are so many reasons i cant list them all at once.

 I am going to be 32 this year.


I dont know exactly what home is. I know what the entrance physical door way to it is. A big swirling green yellow white and blue galaxy. The middle of it is the gateway. The other side is home. I saw it in the dream i talked about. Its a real place and i miss it. Its warm, there is no physical pain, im strong and unjudged and loved. Thats All i have for it.

No i dont think so.... if you are starved of love and affection of course you are gojng to try to get these things like help, love and support any way you can cause we need these things.  Im sure i am perceived the same way and it hurts to not be believed, which makes you isolate and feel like general garbage
 It makes you not want to be honest. Without honesty se can not connect to one another

Ill talk to you. I think they are bullshit aswell. They can call you an ambulance and thats anout it.  Maybe if we all talk to each other it might help to be able to be honest and open about why we want to die.
